legacy.claim: The closed system {draw-sourced 1/r level, inertial rolling rule, coefficient-one shear law} is consistent, parameter-free, and uniquely selects GP with A = √(2GM); consistency forces the shear coefficient k = 1
legacy.evidence: Closed-form derivation (§ closure (b)): Bernoulli against the 1/r level gives ½v² = c²σ = GM/r at every radius; shear+continuity independently give v ∝ r^((k−2)/(k+1)), matching only at k = 1.
